hero.title: {adora} Hotel Management System
hero.subtitle: A comprehensive solution to manage all your hotel operations with high efficiency

features.title: {adora} Features
features.subtitle: A comprehensive system to manage all aspects of the hotel with high efficiency

reception.title: Integrated Reception Management 🏨
reception.desc: Comprehensive guest request management through QR Code, real-time tracking of all requests, and automatic distribution to appropriate departments

housekeeping.title: Housekeeping & Room Management 🛏️
housekeeping.desc: Track room status, comprehensive minibar inspection, housekeeping team management, and detailed reports on room consumption

bellman.title: Smart Bellman Service 🧳
bellman.desc: Luggage transfer management, room transfers, real-time task tracking, and instant notifications for guests upon service completion

maintenance.title: Instant Maintenance Management 🔧
maintenance.desc: Track maintenance requests, prioritize tasks, manage technicians, and reports on response time and completion rate

procurement.title: Procurement & Inventory Management 📦
procurement.desc: Inventory management, purchase orders, supplier tracking, stock-out alerts, and monthly consumption reports

coffee.title: Coffee Shop Management ☕
coffee.desc: Receive guest orders through QR Code, manage menu and prices, and track orders in real-time

chat.title: Smart Chat with Guests 💬
chat.desc: Direct communication with guests, instant notifications, smart automated responses, and comprehensive conversation tracking

points.title: Points & Rewards System 🎮
points.desc: Motivate employees with points and ranks system, 20 different ranks, badges and achievements, and cash point redemption

loyalty.title: Guest Loyalty System ⭐
loyalty.desc: Track Respect Score for guests, VIP levels (Platinum, Gold, Silver), and customized services for premium guests

reports.title: Comprehensive Reports & Analytics 📊
reports.desc: KPI dashboard, performance reports, revenue analysis, employee reports, and customizable exportable reports

multiBranch.title: Multi-Branch Management 🌐
multiBranch.desc: Manage multiple branches from one dashboard, unified reports, comprehensive statistics, and centralized employee management

alerts.title: Instant Smart Alerts 🔔
alerts.desc: Critical delay alerts, urgent request notifications, stock-out alerts, and Push notifications for employees

security.title: Security First 🔐
security.subtitle: System protected with the highest security standards

tenantIsolation.title: Tenant Isolation
tenantIsolation.desc: Complete data isolation for each tenant

rbac.title: RBAC
rbac.desc: Role-based Access Control at all levels

encryptedTokens.title: Encrypted Tokens
encryptedTokens.desc: Encrypted and secure QR Tokens for guests

atomicOps.title: Atomic Operations
atomicOps.desc: All critical operations protected with Transactions

auditLogs.title: Audit Logs
auditLogs.desc: Comprehensive logs for all sensitive operations

monitoring.title: Real-time Monitoring
monitoring.desc: Real-time monitoring to detect any suspicious activity
